# Sort the dataframe by year in descending order to get the most recent competitions
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by='year', ascending=False)

# Get the last two competitions (most recent two years)
last_two = df_sorted.head(2)

# Extract the distance from the 'competition' column for these two competitions
# The distance is the numeric part before the space and 'm'
distances = last_two['competition'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)')[0].astype(float)

# Calculate the average of these distances
average_distance = distances.mean()

# Check if the average is equal to 78.27 m (within a small tolerance for floating point)
answer = abs(average_distance - 78.27) < 1e-2
